QuestInfo.name: [Star World] Brighten the Skies
QuestInfo.0: Queen Staria of Summeron, a kingdom in Star World, offered to create constellations for Maple World. Visit the queen to learn more.
QuestInfo.2: According to Queen Staria, you have to grant the requests of people who have strong desires to create constellations for Maple World.\r\nVisit the rulers of each kingdom in Star World to learn more.
